children: Private exporters reported sales of 303,300 metric tons of corn to Mexico--272,820 tons for the 2026/27 marketing year and 30,480 tons for 2027/28, the USDA says. Soybean sales for 2026/27 include 134,000 tons to China, 120,000 tons to Vietnam and 100,000 tons to unknown destinations. CBOT futures are picking up from yesterday's weakness, with corn up 1.1%, soybeans climbing 1.2% and wheat rising 1.5%. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
